maya: heads up — after the RBAC canary this morning, we're seeing a spike in SCIM-provisioner errors and audit log growth. ~20% of SCIM creates are 403 'decrypt failed'. logs below.

alec: link? what error code? :eyes:

maya: pasted sample log below:
```
scim-provisioner ERROR: provisioning failed user=svc_tom@example.com err="kms:decrypt: invalid_envelope_header"
trace: kmsclient.Decrypt -> envelope.parse header.alg="A256GCM" expected="RSA-OAEP"
http 403 {"error":"KMS decryption failed", "key_id":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/abcd"}
```

sam: did the IdP change? looks like attribute encryption moved to AES-GCM JWE (direct) vs RSA-wrapped CEK. our envelope parser currently expects RSA-OAEP-wrapped CEK.

jordan-oncall: any recent key rotation? kms-bot reported rotation at 3654319000

kms-bot: key-rotation: key/abcd rotated -> new-key/ef01 at 3654319000, metadata.alg_supported=["RSA-OAEP","RSA-OAEP-256"]

alec: rotation doesn't explain A256GCM in header. could be IdP switched to JWE direct (dir) or a different encryption profile. can we get the raw assertion?

maya: attached sanitized assertion snippet (attribute encryption header shows alg="A256GCM" enc="A256GCM"). running local decrypt harness now.

sam: triage steps: 
- confirm IdP alg config (Okta/Azure) for SAML attribute encryption
- try decrypt with tools/kms-decrypt-test --raw-envelope <file>
- if IdP cannot switch, either add JWE-direct fallback in envelope parser or build an adapter to unwrap CEK via KMS then decrypt AES-GCM payload

maya: ran harness -> same invalid header error.

maya: quick mitigation suggestion: pause RBAC canary (stop role-update writes to provisioner) and stop logging raw assertions to avoid PII leakage; queue failed SCIM operations for backfill. we should notify CS for affected tenants.

alec: agreed. pausing canary now and opening incident. tagging @oncall.

jordan-oncall: incident created: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-saml-kms — canary paused.

sam: long-term plan: add unit tests for envelope header heuristics, add compatibility adapter for JWE-direct/A256GCM, and alert when tenant IdP assertion encryption deviates from expected.

maya: FYI audit logs doubled because we currently log the full assertion on decrypt errors. switching to masked logging per runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/logging-pii

alec: plan ack. i'll coordinate with eng-platform for a small parser patch on the canary tomorrow and reach out to tenant IdP admins to verify encryption profile (okta support ticket queued).

maya: thanks — keeping thread for postmortem. :thumbsup:
